the fabrication of stable Ag-Au-organic frameworks, and the Ag-Au-Mil-101 substrate has been applied to the detection of thiabandazole in real samples.
the fabrication of a stable Ag-Au-organic frameworks and its application in the sensitive detection of thiobendazole in juice.
a simple and effective approach for the fabrication of Ag-Au- IP 6 -Mil -101(Fe) and its application in sensitive detection of TBZ in juice.

this study provides a new strategy for rapid and sensitive detection of thiobendazole in food and environmental samples.
the as-prepared Ag- Au-IP 8 -Mil-101 substrate is a good SERS substrate and has great potential for the detection of thiabednzole and degradation of organic dyes.
the fabrication of Ag-Au-organic-frameworks is simple and effective.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ag-Au- IP 6 -Mil101(Fe) can be applied as an effective substrate for sensitive detection of TBZ in juice and as a promising peroxidase mimicking catalyst.
the Ag-Au-metalorganic-frameworks with the assistance of IP 6 could be applied for sensitive detection of organic molecules and degradation of organic dyes.

Ag-Au- IP 6 -Mil101 (Fe) is a stable and efficient SERS substrate for the detection of TBZ in juice.
